paragraphs: The X3 30 xDrive is part of the new G45 generation of the BMW X3, introduced for model year 2025 — a full redesign, not just a facelift of the previous G01 generation. It uses the B48, BMW's 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. The G45 generation's B48 is a revised version of the engine that powered the previous-generation X3, with updates to meet current emissions standards and deliver refined performance. BMW's B48 engine family has become the backbone of the brand's four-cylinder petrol lineup, known for its balance of efficiency and power delivery across the BMW range.
about.boldParagraph: The X3 30 xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
